segment.source: Simulate evolution with agents that search for food, reproduce and pass on mutating genes. Inspect individual agents and analyze population and gene distribution in charts.
segment.target: Evolutionem simula cum agentibus qui cibum quaerunt, prolem gignunt et gena quae mutantur tradunt. Singulos agentes inspice et populationem distributionemque genorum in diagrammatibus examina.
